blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Wednesday urged Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano not to drag other public servants into his pronouncement that there is a public sentiment that everyone in government is corrupt. “I speak for myself and other public servants, elected or appointed, who don’t steal public funds or take bribes: HUWAG NAMAN SANA NIYA KAMI IDAMAY,” Lacson wrote in a post on X. (Please don’t drag us into this.) Lacson’s post featured an art card by Pampanga Today quoting Cayetano as saying, “Lahat tayo magnanakaw, lahat kayo, lahat tayo magnanakaw sa gobyerno.” (We are all thieves. […]...
